comportamentos: Item 1 – the student-screen caller passes dismissal_date and the partial reads it via local_assigns: partial (the partial uses local_assigns, but _show_dismissal does not pass dismissal_date, so the affiliation is not looked up by dismissal date)
Item 2 – expired session (empty session) redirects to login with a message and sends no e-mail: partial (redirects to root_path, not new_user_session_path)

Item 2 – live session with a mismatched token notifies and returns the user to the previous page with an alert: missing (the candidate re-raises the exception, so the user still sees the 422 error page)
Item 2 – non-navigational request gets 422: present (via re-raise)
Item 3 – composite rebuilt on input and on form submit in all three widgets: present
Item 4 – submission without record redirects with a message in create and update: present (different translation key and redirect target, same observable effect)
Item 5 – semester without a calendar redirects with an informative message instead of AccessDenied: present (different translation key)
Item 6 – invalid date shows a warning and simulates with the default date: partial (rescues the error and uses args={}, but the simulate view does not render flash, so the warning never appears)
justificativa: The candidate covers the gist of most items, but on CSRF it neither returns live sessions to the previous page nor redirects expired ones to login, the student caller does not pass dismissal_date, and the simulation warning is never displayed.
